title: Nutty Smoky Russian Knafeh Skillet
description: A smoky and crumbly one-pot Russian dish featuring knafeh, with a mirepoix base, made Whole30 friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Russia with the crunch of knafeh.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the smoked salmon and cook until heated through.
Crumble the knafeh dough into the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and season with salt and black pepper.
